test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

My mom told me __to have cleaning up__ the kitchen before I go outside.
solution:
The correct answer is "**to clean up **".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of the **auxiliary verb "have"** is grammatically **incorrect**.
 
• The auxiliary verb "**have**" is commonly used with the **past participle form of the verb** to make the present or past perfect tense.
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of the **gerund form **of the main verb "**cleaning**" is also grammatically **incorrect **as the given sentence is in the** past tense**.
 
• We need to use the **infinitive form **of the verb "**to clean up**" in the given sentence.
 
• We use the infinitive form of the verb to show an **intention **or **purpose of an action.**
 
• In the given sentence, the** infinitive verb** "to clean up" conveys the **intention **of the speaker's mother that the kitchen should be cleaned before the speaker goes outside.

**The correct sentence is**: *My mom told me** ****to clean up__** the kitchen before I go outside. *

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.
